programme.title: Meet China: Flying into the Future, Growing a Greener City, and Connecting Business to the World
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we explore how the future is taking shape across different corners of China and beyond. From Guangzhou's rising low-altitude economy powered by electric flying cars, to Xiamen's practical path toward zero-carbon urban life, we see how innovation is changing the way people live and cities grow. We also step into China's booming livestream shopping culture, where commerce becomes community, and travel to Malaysia's rice fields, where Chinese agricultural expertise is helping improve harvests and food security. This episode reveals how technology, industry and creativity are turning bold ideas into everyday reality.

programme.title: Proof over Promise: Insights on Real-World AI Adoption
programme.desc: At a moment when artificial intelligence is moving beyond hype into measurable impact, the key question is no longer what AI can do—but how it delivers at scale. From manufacturing floors to energy systems, the race is on to turn promise into proof. As home to one of the fastest-moving AI deployment environments, how is China translating policy into large-scale industrial application?Join BizTalk as we team up with the World Economic Forum, bringing together leaders from WEF, CATL, and Schneider Electric to explore how AI is being driven by real business needs, and how it’s redefining the future of intelligent manufacturing.

programme.title: China's concert boom: Why Gen Z is filling the stadiums
programme.desc: From packed stadium shows to sold-out performances in smaller cities, China's live music scene is expanding rapidly. Young audiences are turning concerts into a cultural routine: traveling across cities, sharing the experience online and building collective memories around live performances.The boom now extends far beyond the stage, boosting tourism, retail spending and local economies. In this episode of Unboxing China, we explore how concerts are reshaping consumption patterns and becoming a new driver of cultural and urban development.

programme.title: Headline：A Chinese village run by a CEO
programme.desc: In a Dai village called "Manluanzhan" near China's southwestern border, a full-time rural CEO manages the books and coordinates business operations at homestays, cafés, breweries, and other shops. But how to benefit from rural tourism without losing the village charm?In Manluanzhan, a fresh experiment is unfolding – one where villagers remain participants, investors, and decision-makers, but a CEO enters the fray to help defend their interests.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 Herculaneum Scrolls: Unraveling History
programme.desc: The eruption of Mount Vesuvius is renowned for its decimation of Pompeii, but nearby, an equally impressive Roman settlement known as Herculaneum was lost to history.

programme.title: Bronze Age
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Part 1: Rise of Civilization
programme.desc: In the region that includes the Mediterranean, the Aegean, Mesopotamia and Egypt, the Bronze Age arrived about 3000 BC and lasted nearly 2000 years. What singled out this period and the new societies and cities that emerged? The development of formal writing is one among several important factors.

programme.title: Bronze Age
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Part 2: Masters Of Trade
programme.desc: Trade, and in particular trade in luxury goods, drove the commerce economies of the Bronze Age. This is the time when the first super powers in history, Egypt and Mesopotamia, emerge and dominate the "world" stage of the Mediterranean and Aegean seas and surrounding areas.

programme.title: Bronze Age
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Part 3: Conquest And Collapse
programme.desc: The Bronze Age had the first large urban centers, powerful kingdoms and armies, writing, and trade routes across vast areas. What led to the collapse of the city-state entities and the end of the Bronze Age? Possibly a perfect storm of uncontrollable factors that are still being researched.

programme.title: Deep Time History
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Episode 1: The Rise Of Civilization
programme.desc: About 8,000 BC, in a few select places some people begin to experiment with a new way of harvesting energy. They’re growing their own crops.

programme.title: Deep Time History
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Episode 2: The Age Of Discovery
programme.desc: Columbus has no idea that because of Earth’s geology and geography he won't get to his destination…or how that failure made his voyage one of the most influential.

programme.title: Deep Time History
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Episode 3: The Industrial Revolution And Modern Warfare
programme.desc: How do prehistoric forests link to the development of steam engines, and the rise of modern industry?

programme.title: The Vikings
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 The Vikings: Origin of the Vikings
programme.desc: From the ice fields of the North to the Russian steppe, these fearsome Scandinavian warriors sailed the globe for three centuries spreading their net of trade and pillage

programme.title: The Vikings
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 The Vikings: Early Viking Society and Religion
programme.desc: In this episode, we learn how early Viking society developed, what the sacred rituals really were, and what role women played in Viking religion.

programme.title: The Vikings
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 The Vikings: The Ships of the Vikings
programme.desc: Ships carried Nordic warriors all the way from their Scandinavian homes to lands of conquest. How were these ergonomic ships built and what made them so special?

programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 The Vikings: Weapons of the Vikings

programme.title: Vicious Beauties - The secret World of the Jelly Fish

programme.title: Predators of a Different Kind - In the World of the Unknown Sharks
programme.desc: With the aid of modern technology, reveal the unknown behaviour of some unusual species of shark: lemon sharks and their white-tip reef counterparts. Our film trip begins on the Bahamas. To be more precise: in the turquoise-blue waters of the Grand Bahama Bank, in an exactly fixed location. In the spring, 70 – 80 pregnant lemon sharks arrive here. This huge shark population was first discovered just a few years ago by shark researcher, Professor Sam Gruber. Many of the females are tired and rest on the seabed. Pregnant tiger sharks swim in the midst of this group. Without any protection whatsoever, our cameramen shoot their footage, surrounded by sharks and succeed in capturing images...

programme.title: Symphony of the Seas - Underwater Wonders of Australia's Ocean
programme.desc: Our journeys take us all around the world from Patagonia to the USA, from Greenland to South Africa and from Cambodia to Australia and leads us to the most fascinating places where landscapes animals and humans are the main focus of our documentaries. Whether on land or at sea – the last paradises of the world are our destination.

programme.title: Giants of Fortune - The Whale Sharks of Oslob
programme.desc: In the little Filipino village of Oslob on the Cebu Island, people suffer from typhoons and overfishing. Until the world’s biggest fish and the Internet change everything.Fisherman Zosimo’s dearest wish is for his children to graduate from high school one day. Yet the chance that this wish will come true is tiny, since at times Zosimo doesn’t even manage to feed the family. Typhoons and overfishing make the lives of Oslob fishermen difficult.

programme.title: Wild Pacific - The Beauty of Life
programme.desc: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest of Earth's oceanic divisions. It extends from the Arctic Ocean in the north to the Southern Ocean.

programme.title: Mysterious Oceanic Oases - Hotspots of Life
programme.desc: Countless marine animals frolic on the steep slopes of underwater volcanoes. In many cases, several are rare species not found elsewhere. This is in part due to the fact that plankton clings to the wall and provides the fish with food in abundance. This documentary shows several of these oases and also examines the impact dive tourism has and whether preventive measures can help to maintain them. Nature and underwater filmmaker Rolf Möltgen undertakes dives into the mysterious underwater mountain landscapes with marine scientists from all corners of the globe. This journey takes us to Mexico, to snappers, white-tip reef sharks, Galapagos sharks and giant mantas. We visit the Maldives,...

programme.title: The Last Paradises: Patagonia - Coast of the Killer Whale
programme.desc: On the wild coast of Patagonia, the nature calendar describes the most diverse visiting times of fascinating animals, from the southern right whale and other large whales, via the sea lions and elephant seals up to the orcas and millions of penguins. The encounters with whales and their babies are spectacular. Hardly anywhere else on earth can one experience both the brutal and the delightful sides of nature so vividly and so close. The trip to the hot spots for animal watchers and researchers leads us inter alia to the Caleta Valdez. This is where, during the mating season, the southern elephant seals bring their babies into the world, mate and enjoy a little sunbathing on the beach.

programme.title: Lobsters - The Knights Of The Deep
programme.desc: The knights of the deep are on the move; almost no part of their bodies is without armor. Like medieval warriors, these fighters are well armed – not with sword and shield, but with scissors and forceps and defensive armor that is covered with spikes and hooks. And even though they are well protected and have an uncanny awareness of their surroundings, many of these proud knights will face a gloomy destiny. Many of them will end upon a plate. Gourmets all over the world are in love with these famous crustaceans: lobsters! For marine biologists lobsters are similarly fascinating: as research objects. We are on their trail in Cape Breton, an island in the northern Atlantic and part of the...

programme.title: Mantises - Masters of Deception
programme.desc: They are killers. They kill with unbelievable precision. They fight Kung Fu style and are seen in Japan as a symbol of vigilance - the mantises. Their triangular head with its unique flexibility is conspicuous. Two overdimensioned eyes fixate the distance to their prey rapidly and three-dimensionally. The chest segment of the mantis is prolonged and equipped with spiny appendages that can spear their prey as fast as a jack knife. The mysterious aura that surrounds the praying mantis has a lot to do with the fact that they are rarely seen. They have adapted to their surroundings perfectly. No matter whether leaves, blossoms, tree bark, sandy floors or even orchids - the mantis adjusts to...

programme.title: Vicious Beauties - The secret World of the Jelly Fish
programme.desc: Watching the graceful movement of these gelatinous animals is almost hypnotic. Although their bodies are 98% water, jellyfish are deceptively clever and dangerous. But where do these primordial creatures come from? How do they reproduce and how long do they live?

programme.title: Predators of a Different Kind - In the World of the Unknown Sharks
programme.desc: With the aid of modern technology, reveal the unknown behaviour of some unusual species of shark: lemon sharks and their white-tip reef counterparts. Our film trip begins on the Bahamas. To be more precise: in the turquoise-blue waters of the Grand Bahama Bank, in an exactly fixed location. In the spring, 70 – 80 pregnant lemon sharks arrive here. This huge shark population was first discovered just a few years ago by shark researcher, Professor Sam Gruber. Many of the females are tired and rest on the seabed. Pregnant tiger sharks swim in the midst of this group. Without any protection whatsoever, our cameramen shoot their footage, surrounded by sharks and succeed in capturing images...

programme.title: Symphony of the Seas - Underwater Wonders of Australia's Ocean
programme.desc: Our journeys take us all around the world from Patagonia to the USA, from Greenland to South Africa and from Cambodia to Australia and leads us to the most fascinating places where landscapes animals and humans are the main focus of our documentaries. Whether on land or at sea – the last paradises of the world are our destination.

programme.title: Giants of Fortune - The Whale Sharks of Oslob
programme.desc: In the little Filipino village of Oslob on the Cebu Island, people suffer from typhoons and overfishing. Until the world’s biggest fish and the Internet change everything.Fisherman Zosimo’s dearest wish is for his children to graduate from high school one day. Yet the chance that this wish will come true is tiny, since at times Zosimo doesn’t even manage to feed the family. Typhoons and overfishing make the lives of Oslob fishermen difficult.

programme.title: Wild Pacific - The Beauty of Life
programme.desc: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest of Earth's oceanic divisions. It extends from the Arctic Ocean in the north to the Southern Ocean.

programme.title: Mysterious Oceanic Oases - Hotspots of Life
programme.desc: Countless marine animals frolic on the steep slopes of underwater volcanoes. In many cases, several are rare species not found elsewhere. This is in part due to the fact that plankton clings to the wall and provides the fish with food in abundance. This documentary shows several of these oases and also examines the impact dive tourism has and whether preventive measures can help to maintain them. Nature and underwater filmmaker Rolf Möltgen undertakes dives into the mysterious underwater mountain landscapes with marine scientists from all corners of the globe. This journey takes us to Mexico, to snappers, white-tip reef sharks, Galapagos sharks and giant mantas. We visit the Maldives,...

programme.title: The Last Paradises: Patagonia - Coast of the Killer Whale
programme.desc: On the wild coast of Patagonia, the nature calendar describes the most diverse visiting times of fascinating animals, from the southern right whale and other large whales, via the sea lions and elephant seals up to the orcas and millions of penguins. The encounters with whales and their babies are spectacular. Hardly anywhere else on earth can one experience both the brutal and the delightful sides of nature so vividly and so close. The trip to the hot spots for animal watchers and researchers leads us inter alia to the Caleta Valdez. This is where, during the mating season, the southern elephant seals bring their babies into the world, mate and enjoy a little sunbathing on the beach.

programme.title: mareTV: Majorca
programme.desc: "Cleaning woman island", concrete castles, Ballermann: Mallorca's image is negatively affected in some respects. The documentary explores the charm of the largest Balearic island beyond the hustle and bustle of tourism and Rambazamba. The "real" Mallorca is best explored through real Majorcans: Manolo Barahona, TV fishing expert from the local island broadcaster IB3, faces the most difficult task of the year. The Raor is in season, the most expensive fish on the island. Manolo is supposed to get him first in front of the camera and then in the pan. There's only one catch, the little fish with the piranha teeth just doesn't want to be on TV. In the first months of the year Mallorca turns...

programme.title: Menorca - Majorca's beautiful sister
programme.desc: Not nearly as crowded as Majorca or Ibiza: Menorca has noticeably fewer visitors than her sister islands and in 1993, was recognised by UNESCO as a biosphere re-serve. Menorca also has its own distinctive charm, with its secluded coves, mighty cliffs, beautiful gardens and ages old towns and villages. Its residents love the is-lands treasures and peculiarities. Forests make up al-most a third of Menorca, complemented by many lush green meadows. Next to tourism, agriculture is a major source of the island's income to the present day. On Menorca, there are several accumulations of enormous megalithic stones. From a global point of view, the up to five-metre-tall "Taulas", whereby the stones...

programme.title: mareTV: Ibiza - Island of Light
programme.desc: The light of the Balearic island of Ibiza is magical and its trademark: The "Island of Light" is tiny compared to its sister island Mallorca, but offers the most beautiful sunsets in the world. That's what they say. They attract sun worshippers and party people from near and far. To the sounds of the famous "Balearic Sound" they turn night into day. This documentary documents the island in the balancing act between luxury yachts and traditions. Hippie culture, celebrities, pine forests, bays with turquoise water and villages with bright white houses: Ibiza has many faces. Mora (80) and Djin (67) have been drawn to the island for 55 years. They are the uncrowned kings of the hippies. But...

programme.title: mareTV: Tenerife - The Queen of the Canaries
programme.desc: Tenerife is outstanding among the Canary Islands. If only because of the volcano Pico del Teide, which rises exactly 3.718 meters above sea level and is thus the highest mountain in Spain. But not only scenically Tenerife, the largest of the Canary Islands, stands out...

programme.title: Fuerteventura: The golden beauty of the Canaries
programme.desc: Fuerteventura, the second largest of the Canary Islands, is located just 120 kilometres off the coast of West Africa. The climate is extremely dry and the struggle for water has always been a major setback. Then, around a century ago, returning US emigrants brought what were then modern wind turbine water pumps from the Aermotor Windmill Company with them to Fuerte-ventura. Today, the environmentally friendly and so-called “Chicago’s”, experience a renaissance. Unfortu-nately, original spare parts in good condition are diffi-cult to come by. When Leocadio Araya Sanchez began planting countless cacti on a barren hillside a few years ago, people thought he was mad. His idea was to make a...

programme.title: Dream Islands of Europe: Lanzarote and Fuerteventura
programme.desc: The film presents the two Canary Islands Lanzarote and Fuerteventura. Lanzarote has a rich culture in addition to a volcanic landscape: the film accompanies a ceramic artist, an instrument maker, shows architecture by César Manrique and a camel breeder. On Fuerteventura, in addition to livestock farming and the operation of traditional grain mills, nature conservation plays a major role: islanders are committed to preserving the sand dunes, and there is a turtle hatchery. On Lanzarote, countless volcanic eruptions have formed a bizarre lunar landscape. It is a great challenge for the inhabitants to extract the cultivation of food from the karstic, dry soil. And yet they even manage to...

programme.desc: With the aid of modern technology, reveal the unknown behaviour of some unusual species of shark: lemon sharks and their white-tip reef counterparts. Our film trip begins on the Bahamas. To be more precise: in the turquoise-blue waters of the Grand Bahama Bank, in an exactly fixed location. In the spring, 70 – 80 pregnant lemon sharks arrive here. This huge shark population was first discovered just a few years ago by shark researcher, Professor Sam Gruber. Many of the females are tired and rest on the seabed. Pregnant tiger sharks swim in the midst of this group. Without any protection whatsoever, our cameramen shoot their footage, surrounded by sharks and succeed in capturing images...

programme.title: Symphony of the Seas - Underwater Wonders of Australia's Ocean
programme.desc: Our journeys take us all around the world from Patagonia to the USA, from Greenland to South Africa and from Cambodia to Australia and leads us to the most fascinating places where landscapes animals and humans are the main focus of our documentaries. Whether on land or at sea – the last paradises of the world are our destination.

programme.title: Giants of Fortune - The Whale Sharks of Oslob
programme.desc: In the little Filipino village of Oslob on the Cebu Island, people suffer from typhoons and overfishing. Until the world’s biggest fish and the Internet change everything.Fisherman Zosimo’s dearest wish is for his children to graduate from high school one day. Yet the chance that this wish will come true is tiny, since at times Zosimo doesn’t even manage to feed the family. Typhoons and overfishing make the lives of Oslob fishermen difficult.

programme.title: Wild Pacific - The Beauty of Life
programme.desc: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest of Earth's oceanic divisions. It extends from the Arctic Ocean in the north to the Southern Ocean.

programme.title: Mysterious Oceanic Oases - Hotspots of Life
programme.desc: Countless marine animals frolic on the steep slopes of underwater volcanoes. In many cases, several are rare species not found elsewhere. This is in part due to the fact that plankton clings to the wall and provides the fish with food in abundance. This documentary shows several of these oases and also examines the impact dive tourism has and whether preventive measures can help to maintain them. Nature and underwater filmmaker Rolf Möltgen undertakes dives into the mysterious underwater mountain landscapes with marine scientists from all corners of the globe. This journey takes us to Mexico, to snappers, white-tip reef sharks, Galapagos sharks and giant mantas. We visit the Maldives,...

programme.title: The Last Paradises: Patagonia - Coast of the Killer Whale
programme.desc: On the wild coast of Patagonia, the nature calendar describes the most diverse visiting times of fascinating animals, from the southern right whale and other large whales, via the sea lions and elephant seals up to the orcas and millions of penguins. The encounters with whales and their babies are spectacular. Hardly anywhere else on earth can one experience both the brutal and the delightful sides of nature so vividly and so close. The trip to the hot spots for animal watchers and researchers leads us inter alia to the Caleta Valdez. This is where, during the mating season, the southern elephant seals bring their babies into the world, mate and enjoy a little sunbathing on the beach.

programme.title: Lobsters - The Knights Of The Deep
programme.desc: The knights of the deep are on the move; almost no part of their bodies is without armor. Like medieval warriors, these fighters are well armed – not with sword and shield, but with scissors and forceps and defensive armor that is covered with spikes and hooks. And even though they are well protected and have an uncanny awareness of their surroundings, many of these proud knights will face a gloomy destiny. Many of them will end upon a plate. Gourmets all over the world are in love with these famous crustaceans: lobsters! For marine biologists lobsters are similarly fascinating: as research objects. We are on their trail in Cape Breton, an island in the northern Atlantic and part of the...

programme.title: Mantises - Masters of Deception
programme.desc: They are killers. They kill with unbelievable precision. They fight Kung Fu style and are seen in Japan as a symbol of vigilance - the mantises. Their triangular head with its unique flexibility is conspicuous. Two overdimensioned eyes fixate the distance to their prey rapidly and three-dimensionally. The chest segment of the mantis is prolonged and equipped with spiny appendages that can spear their prey as fast as a jack knife. The mysterious aura that surrounds the praying mantis has a lot to do with the fact that they are rarely seen. They have adapted to their surroundings perfectly. No matter whether leaves, blossoms, tree bark, sandy floors or even orchids - the mantis adjusts to...

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 Angry Planet | Volcanic Wedding
programme.desc: Host George Kourounis has braved many terrifying phenomena – but none as frightening as the one he takes on in this episode: marriage! To make sure his new bride is on the same adventurous page with him, he proposes to get married on the lip of an exploding volcano, on the South Pacific island of Tanna, in Vanuatu. Before the native preacher, dressed in grass skirt and kustom garb, gets to perform the smoky vows, George descends into the erupting volcano to bring out red hot samples of the lava it is producing.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Avalanche danger is very high in the Rogers Pass area of the Trans Canada Highway in British Columbia. Host of Angry Planet George Kourounis travels with a variety of experts to bring down huge avalanches in the Rocky Mountains. Ski Patrollers throw hand charges to clear the slopes, the British Columbia Department of Highways uses helicopter bombing and mountaintop mortars to keep the roads safe, and the Canadian Armed Forces fire 105mm howitzers at the mountains to bring down the dangerous snow. Still, there are accidents and fatalities in the mountains. We meet Francois Desroisers, an avalanche burial victim who tells a terrible and tragic tale of a mountain disaster.

programme.desc: George returns to “Tornado Alley” with 3 fellow stormchasers to see what the 2007 Storm Season will bring.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Angry Planet | African Hellhole
programme.desc: The Angry Planet team heads to Africa to climb the steep and very active Nyiragongo Volcano in the Congo that erupted in 2002, sending 125,000 people fleeing for their lives. Host/adventurer George Kourounis explores the bubbling lake of molten lava and investigates the risk the dangerous volcano poses to both the people of city of Goma and the Mountain Gorillas who live on the nearby jungle slopes.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 Angry Planet | The Winds of Autumn
programme.desc: The autumn of 2006 brings hurricanes to the North Atlantic and hot dry winds fan forest fires across Northern Ontario. Host/adventurer George Kourounis has traveled to some awesome hurricanes, including Rita and Katrina, with his pal Mark Robinson. This year they stormchase in Newfoundland, site of the hurricane that pulled Mark out of a life-threatening depression.

Who could have despised Richard Alessandri enough to kill him in cold blood in his own bed? Was he the victim of a robbery gone wrong, as claimed by his wife?

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Dire Deception (LAURENCE MAILLE CASE): On November 28, 2007, Laurence Maille disappeared. It was her partner, John Zablevski, who alerted the Vimy police in Pas-de-Calais. He explained that the young woman had left in the morning for a walk with their dog and never returned. An unprecedented search was immediately launched to try to find her. Beautiful, intelligent and generous, Laurence Maille had everything to be happy about and for 18 months, had found the perfect love in her partner.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The Mystery of Room 602 (Véronique Pirotton Case): On October 31, 2013, Belgian politician Bernard Ouessfal rushed down the six flights of a hotel in Ostend where he had met up with his wife, Véronique, the day before. He had just found her unconscious on the bathroom floor with a mysterious plastic bag next to her. Despite the emergency rescue response, Véronique Pirotton died a few minutes later.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Two Accused of Murder (Jennifer Charron Case) - On Sunday, April 29, 2007, the body of Jennifer Charron, 21-years old, was found burnt to a crisp in a forest near Royan. The young waitress, who had been missing for two days, was visibly beaten and tied up. In this astonishing case, the clues examined by the experts will give them two leads: two men, two suspects with very different profiles... but investigators are convinced that they both have a direct link with the murder.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: THE CASE OF STÉPHANE KAMEUGNE - On December 24, 2008, the body of Stéphane Kameugne was fished out from a canal in Châlons-en-Champagne. The young man had been missing for two weeks and no one had seen him since the evening of his graduation ceremony from his engineering school. A theory soon emerged: the very drunk student had fallen over thea bridge over the canal which led to his death. But his parents and relatives did not believe this.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)- On March 31, 2003, firefighters were called to a fire in a housing estate of Meyrargues, near Aix-en-Provence. On site, they discovered a horrific scene: the tortured and charred bodies of a mother and her daughter, Chantal and Audrey D'Amato, aged 53 and 24 respectively.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case) - On June 18, 2011, Marie-Jeanne Meyer, 17-years old, waved goodbye to her little sister before leaving for her daily jog on the heights of Tournon in Ardèche. She never came back. Three days later, her mutilated body was found in a freshly dug pit, near an area known to be cursed, "The Devil's Plateau." What's more, the crime scene looked like a mystical ritual ... Was it a ritual murder? Revenge? An unfortunate encounter? ...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Mysterious Murder at the Farm (Valérie Bary Case)- On Friday, March 26, 2004, in the region of Dijon, Laurent Bary came home from his work to discover the lifeless body of his wife, Valerie, bathing in a pool of blood. According to the investigators' initial findings, the 38-year-old nurse's aid had been stabbed several times, seeming to validate the theory of a robbery gone wrong.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On July 13, 2011, two boaters retrieved a suitcase that was floating in the bay of Lorient. Inside, they discovered the tied up corpse of a man.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake (CASE OF RUTH LÉGERET) - On January 4, 2006, Ruth Légeret was found dead in the middle of a pool of blood at her luxurious property in Vevey, Switzerland. Next to her was the lifeless body of her friend, Marina Studer. Who could have killed these two simple and wealthy widows? Clue after clue, the Swiss police's investigation would revolve around an environment of family jealousy and financial greed.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: September 16 2005. The lifeless body of Audrey Jouannet, 24, is found hidden under the bed in her small apartment in Soisy-sur-Seine. It soon becomes apparent that the young woman has been tortured at length before being strangled. But surprisingly, though the highly meticulous murderer has taken care to leave no sign of his passage, the autopsy reveals traces of sperm on the victim. It will take all of the investigators' intuition to pierce the mystery of this heinous crime...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Sylvain Dromard finds the body of his wife Laurence lying in a pool of blood in the kitchen. The crime was particularly violent and the theory of a burglary that went wrong is soon excluded. But investigators don't understand who could want the adorable hairdresser of Saint-Martin-d'Ablois dead. During the investigation, the work of profilers will enable them to draw a very precise portrait of the murderer...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: After an ordinary dinner, Pierre and Gabrielle Labrell suffer severe abdominal pains.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Nelly Crémel, 39, leaves her home to go jogging... never to return. Eight days later, after a vast search campaign, her body is found. There's no doubt that it's murder. The case soon ignites public opinion, even inflaming passions at the highest level of the state. The clues lead investigators on a number of trails, from the shadows of the French secret service to a manhunt for a possible sex maniac, in a case of murder most foul.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Willy Pomonti, a retired architect, is found savagely murdered in his opulent villa in La Celle-Saint-Cloud, near Paris.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The lifeless body of Christophe Lejard is found by his son just metres from their home.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A man walks into a gendarmerie near Saint-Malo to report that his wife has been missing since the previous day. The couple are going through a divorce, but this mother would never have left her seven children alone! An extensive search is undertaken but the woman cannot be found. What has happened to Adeline Piet? The investigation spans several years and experiences many twists.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The corpse of Priscillia Ciatti, 14, is discovered by the side of a field, a few hundred metres from her family home. The teenager has been stabbed sixty times with a knife and -an extra sordid detail - a devil mask is found next to her body. Was Priscillia the victim of a prowler? A serial killer? A maniac inspired by a horror movie? Investigators soon find that the young girl felt she was being watched, and even threatened...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: In the early hours of the morning, Mathilde Croguennec, 18, attending "Teknival" in Brittany, is found at the foot of a tree with her throat cut. Investigators face the task of finding the killer from among the 43,000 participants of this huge open-air festival of electronic music, where drink and drugs are consumed in abundance. An unusual investigation that leads the police down a number of false avenues.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Arriving at her work, the secretary of a small firm in the suburbs of Geneva finds the body of Jean-Raymond Blatti, the company's new accountant. The man is lying in a pool of blood and, on his belly, the murderer has written "DIRTY RAPIST". Yet Jean-Raymond Blatti was never charged with sexual assault. Over the course of the investigation, this inscription will appear as one of the many mysteries of this case which is particularly rich in twists and turns.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On July 19th 2004, the naked and tied up body of a woman is recovered in the Ourcq canal in Fresnes-sur-Marne. The victim is impossible to identify.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On April 3th 2003, Chantal Ternik, a 48 year old housewife, is discovered hanged in her house of Sanary-sur-Mer, in Var.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On March 28th 2013, the burnt body of Anne Barbot, 38 years old, is discovered in a forest of Maine-et-Loire.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On May 17th 2005, a body is discovered in a forest of Sucy-en-Brie; Christophe Belle, 40 years old, a renowned pastry cook.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The disturbing missing case in Paris of a four year old.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On October 13th 1996, the body of young Angélique Dumetz, 18 years old, is recovered down a ditch in Oise forest. An important clue is found on the crime scene.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On February 23th 2017, policemen are alerted of the disapearrance of Brigitte Troadec, her husband Pascal, and their children Sébastien and Charlotte.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On April 18th 2014, in Visé, Belgium, policemen are informed that gunshots had been fired on the street.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On March 19th 1998, Akira Ojima, a 57 years old japanese architect, is found dead in the fridge of a villa in Nanterre.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On March 21th 1991, Pascale Escarfail, 19 years old, is discovered dead at her studio in the 14th arrondissement of Paris, she was raped then stabbed multiple times.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Did Françoise Desnoue run away? Or did she reattempt to kill herself? Clues will help investigators to see in between the subterfuges and lies, leading them to the terrible truth.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On the morning of July 24th 2009, a fire erupts at house in Plougonvelin. Inside the house, firefighters find the burned body of Jean-Jacques Le Page.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On the morning of January 9th 2014, Josiane Bézard, 53 years old, drives her son to the Manosque's train station, and then vanishes.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On December 9th 1987, the naked body of the young Evelyne Boucher is found near Avignon. An unprecedented investigation begins making headlines.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On May 30th 2015 in Sorinières, Yann Machand reports his wife Céline Marchand missing. Despite a call for evidence and numerous researches, this 39 years old heir, mother of two is nowhere to be found.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Around 11PM the police are called for an assault in a parking lot in the forest of Saint-Lambet-des-Bois.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On January 27th 2014, in Somme-Suippe in the Marne, Sophie Thevenet discovers her husband dead in the garage.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On September 11th 2011, in Èze, near Monaco, the owner of a luxury villa discovers the lifeless hanging body of his tenant, a rich German businessman.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On June 12th 2007, in Berhen-lès-Forbach, in Moselle, a young woman reports the disappearance of her brother Raphaël Lomoro, a 46 years old vanilla producer living in Madagascar.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On November 9th 2007, around 11:30PM, aid arrives on the scene of an accident at the exit of Chateney-en-France.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On September 12, 2013, Eric Mosser, a 45-year-old heating engineer, discovers his wife Isabelle lying in a pool of blood at their home in Illfurth, Alsace.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On February 5, 2000, two hunters discover a charred body on the banks of the Oise.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On July 8, 2002, near Amiens, a farmer discovers the lifeless body of a young woman, Patricia Leclercq, on his field.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On June 30, 2014, in Nancy, the police are called to the home of Julie Martin, a 34-year-old nurse.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On August 11, 1987, the Orléans police discover the bruised corpse of a 4-year-old child behind a guardrail on the A10 motorway.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On December 20, 2012, in Val d'Izé (Ille-et-Vilaine), Aurélie Barbot, 29, was killed on her doorstep with a bullet to the head.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On February 27, 2015, in Toulouse, the parents of 19-year-old Maureen Jacquier discover their daughter stabbed several times in her bed.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On November 9, 2011, the body of a man was found near the Courcelles-le-Comte cemetery (Pas-de-Calais).

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On September 7, 2018, in Strasbourg, Sophie Le Tan is about to celebrate her 20th birthday with her family.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On the night of April 16, 2013, Anaïs Guillaume, 21, mysteriously disappears in Fromy (Ardennes) after spending the evening at her companion's farm.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A damaged bike belonging to 16-year-old Karine Schaaff is found abandoned on the side of a road in Moselle; 10 days later her body is found just kilometers away, hidden in a forest.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The body of Nathalie Villermet, 46, manager of a small hotel and -restaurant, is found by a walker in the woods outside Paris, hidden under branches.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Xavier Flactif, his partner Graziella and their three children suddenly disappear; there are many theories surrounding this mysterious case.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The lifeless, mutilated body of a woman is found in the Rambouillet Forest; the police are perplexed by the clues found at the crime scene and the state of the body which is missing both the head and heart.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Marc Van Beers, a 36-year-old Brussels tax lawyer, dies in a car accident while on his honeymoon; Marc's wife, Aurore, isn't injured in the accident and the case is quickly dismissed; Marc's family is suspicious of Aurore.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: 52-year-old Marina Ciampi is found dead at her home in Marseille; she is found naked on her bed with a plastic bag over her head, but there is no trace of a break-in; police investigate several unknown DNA traces.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On 1 December 2005, Dominique Aubry, a wealthy widow, is found hanged in her houseboat in Neuilly; the case is quickly classified as a suicide, but this argument is problematic.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Firefighters in Barbizieux, Charente are called to a fire at a large house in the village; they arrive to find the lifeless body of the owner, 83-year-old Claude Tavernier, lying in a large pool of blood.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Police in Strasbourg receive a startling emergency call from Doctor Jean-Louis Muller, a forensic pathologist well known in the region.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: 18-year-old Laetitia Perrais is a trainee hotel waitress who vanishes after an evening shift; every attempt is made to shed light on her disappearance and the efforts eventually pay off.

programme.title: Endurance - 24 Hours at Spa S1 - "The Pro Drivers"
programme.desc: In this profile, we get to know the Pro Drivers competing at the 2018 Total 24 Hours of Spa race held at the Spa-Francorchamps circuit.

programme.title: Supercar Showdown S3 - "Tyre Change Challenge"
programme.desc: In a race against the clock, the rookies will work in pairs, each couple changing two tyres on a car. Find out who will make it through to the Semi Final .

programme.title: Supercar Showdown S3 - "Calder Raceway"
programme.desc: The rookies battle it out with each other for the chance to go head to head with their captains, in a feisty simulator challenge.Then it is down to business at Calder Raceway with a tricky challenge that test both speed and memory.

programme.title: Gymkhana Grid Profiles S1 - "Great 8"
programme.desc: Road to Gymkhana Grid: 100% pure adrenalin! Profiling 8 of the sport’s top drivers, we see into their minds and the mental preparation needed to compete.

programme.title: Gymkhana Grid Profiles S1 - "Ken Block"
programme.desc: Founder of The Gymkhana Grid and viral superstar, Ken Block, gives a detailed account of the creation of one of the fastest growing events in the world.

programme.title: Inside Moto S1 - "Race Against or Share With?"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 Race Against or Share With?
programme.desc: We discover the relationship between Brad and Darryn Binder, 2 brothers who race against each other on motorcycle tracks around the world.

programme.title: Inside Moto S1 - "All for Bike"
programme.desc: Sacrifices are found on the path to success: from Yonny Hernandez’s self-exile, to the serious injuries that Doctor Villamor has to treat.

programme.title: The Ultimate Rider S1 - "Britz Base Camp"
programme.desc: Before the rookies can claim the ultimate prize – a testing contract with Team Honda Racing and $20,000 - they must complete a challenging dirt skills session.

programme.title: The Ultimate Rider S1 - "Slow Speed"
programme.desc: To test the rookies’ fundamental skills of accelerating, braking, and cornering, Moto GP legend Daryl Beattie and Team Honda Racing boss Paul Free have designed both a skills session and a points challenge.

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel S1 - "Record Day - Part 1"
programme.desc: The transformation is complete and it’s time for The Flying Kestrel to be put to the test.

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel S1 - "Record Day - Part 2"
programme.desc: The Flying Kestrel takes on the final records attempts, and the shocking results leave everyone reeling.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S17 - "The Road Running Home"
programme.sub-title: S17 : E01 The Road Running Home
programme.desc: Good news from Mark’s daughter Allyssa! She’s pregnant with her fourth child, and this time Mark will have a grandson! Unfortunately, Mark needs to find a replacement to help with his pet project, “The Autopsy Report”.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S17 - "Flight of the Super Bee"
programme.sub-title: S17 : E02 Flight of the Super Bee
programme.desc: Mark and the Ghouls race to finish a one owner 1970 Super Bee that belongs to a decorated retired Marine. But as Mark and Justin forge ahead on this one owner car, a SNAFU on Will's side of the shop may cause a total mission failure.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S17 - "Another Dreamz Machine"
programme.desc: Mark and Justin begin assembly on the ultra rare 1971 Mr. Norm's Dodge Demon. Then the team shifts gears to focus on a Graveyard Dreamz, 1969 Charger tribute car that's made to order.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S17 - "Jonesing for a Road Runner"
programme.sub-title: S17 : E04 Jonesing for a Road Runner
programme.desc: When high profile local car dealer Don Jones Jr. wants to bring back the car of his youth, where does he go? Anywhere he wants! But when your high school dream car is a 1969 Road Runner, your dream shop is Graveyard Carz.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S17 - "Memento Mori"
programme.desc: Graveyard Carz has restored its fair share of 1971 ‘Cudas, so what makes this 1971 Hemi Shaker ‘Cuda so different? Don’t worry, we won’t ruin the surprise. This is the first time in Graveyard Carz broadcasts, that the car will be revealed backwards!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S17 - "Orange You Glad It’s K2?"
programme.sub-title: S17 : E06 Orange You Glad It’s K2?
programme.desc: The Ghouls team up and knuckle down to power through an epic SEMA build! A tribute to a 1970 Dodge T/A Challenger, in a color that Will has never painted: Go Mango! AKA Vitamin C for all the Plymouth fans.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S17 - "The ‘Cuda has a Challenger"
programme.sub-title: S17 : E07 The ‘Cuda has a Challenger
programme.desc: After years of lockdown, the Ghoulz are back at SEMA! But first they need to finish the tribute 1970 Dodge T/A Challenger. This gorgeous custom build is outfitted in the Graveyard’s inimitable, OEM style.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S17 - "Is That a Freckle?"
programme.sub-title: S17 : E08 Is That a Freckle?
programme.desc: Fresh from the flight and still exhausted from the SEMA show in Las Vegas, Mark and the Ghoulz get back to the grind. Will eagerly prepares to paint his very first 1970 AAR ‘Cuda.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S17 - "The Thunder from Down Under"
programme.sub-title: S17 : E09 The Thunder from Down Under
programme.desc: When the local junkyard closes its doors, Mark and Dougie have to rescue an old friend from the earliest days of Graveyard Carz. But their journey appears to be cursed by a sudden increase in thunder and lightning.

programme.desc: A suspect plays it cool when officers try to match a gun to his holster. Poor choices in a parking lot inspire a life coaching moment. Cops respond to a call and learn that good neighbors do exist.

programme.title: Cops
programme.sub-title: S24 : E01 She Came Onto Me
programme.desc: An undercover police officer sets up a sting to buy drugs. Officers find a surprise in a suspect’s trunk. A man claims that a prostitute has kidnapped him.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: Unhappy about getting stopped for drinking while biking, a man takes off on foot. A woman in her PJs doesn’t know how she wound up in a stolen vehicle. Officers discover a couple smoking Meth in front of a young child.

programme.title: Cops
programme.sub-title: S25 : E13 I Take This Criminal
programme.desc: During an arrest, a suspect decides to pop the question to his girlfriend. An abandoned house becomes the target of burglary. Two brothers’ dispute over a business matter leads to violence.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: Deputies respond to a fight between a daughter’s boyfriend and her mother. A woman lights candles after an attempted break-in. Police respond when an evicted tenant tries to reenter his old apartment.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: Officers assist an off-duty deputy being followed by a vehicle trying to force him off of the road. An officer responds to a domestic disturbance call involving a woman and her cheating husband.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: A homeless man hides from deputies in the closet of an empty house. Officers called to a shooting find a man covered in blood. Deputies arrive to a domestic disturbance to find two brothers fighting over a pair of sandals.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: The Organized Crime Unit places officers undercover as drug dealers on a street corner for a drug-reversal sting operation. An Officer responds to a domestic dispute call after a man's property is destroyed by his girlfriend's ill-tempered father. During a routine patrol, an Officer spots an intoxicated man assaulting a woman.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: Officers are called when two intoxicated suspects decide to have some fun and vandalize a fence. Undercover officers set up a narcotics sting at a hotel. A man is found lying naked in a parking lot.

programme.title: Cops
programme.sub-title: S26 : E18 Wrong Place, Wrong Time
programme.desc: A man takes off from officers when they roll up on a notorious hotspot for dealers. Cops surprise a jaywalker when they find some suspicious items in his supposedly borrowed jacket. A woman takes the heat for her beau when meth is found in their car.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: A suspect flees from police and attempts to hide contraband from them. A driver is pulled over and is literally covered in his crimes. An employee of a cell phone store attempts to scam the police and her employers.

programme.title: Cops
programme.sub-title: S13 : E34 Fast Pase Foot Chase
programme.desc: A high speed vehicular pursuit results in foot chase and subsequent arrest. Officers respond to a domestic call involving the residence’s girlfriend and her children who destroyed the man’s house. Police respond to a domestic violence call.

programme.title: Cops
programme.sub-title: S23 : E20 Now It's Lawn Furniture
programme.desc: A traffic stop over a broken brake light turns into a foot chase. A man handles bad news by throwing his furniture out of the window. A vehicle pursuit ends with a K-9 unit’s help.

programme.title: Cops
programme.sub-title: S23 : E21 Don't Make her Angry
programme.desc: A man needs police assistance when his angry ex-girlfriend crawls through his window. Police must play hide-and-seek when they attempt to execute an arrest warrant. A man is threatened with violence when he refuses to turn his car’s headlights off.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: Officers are flagged down and alerted to a group of armed men assaulting people at a nearby home. A fight between a father and his adult son takes a dark turn. A father threatens his daughter and her boyfriend with a knife.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: Officers arrest a couple during an argument over narcotics. Police seize a large bag of marijuana after a routine stop. A man is caught harboring drugs under his tongue during questioning.

programme.title: Cops
programme.sub-title: S26 : E09 Guns, Hash, and Fire Hydrants
programme.desc: A chase becomes a flash flood when a fleeing driver runs into a fire hydrant. An insolent domestic violence suspect claims his girlfriend is a habitual 9-1-1 caller. Officers recover a cornucopia of contraband from a gun-toting couple.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: An ex-felon threatens to kill his spouse after she announces she want to divorce him. A driver is stopped with suspicious plants in her car. A woman crashes her friends truck into a pedestrian and a tree.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: Officers discover a grand theft auto suspect hiding in his apartment. Officers assist the fire department in capturing a brown bear from a palm tree. Officers respond to a shooting.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: A hit and run call results in the intoxicated suspect being coaxed out of his car at gun-point. Officers respond to a stabbing and the victim is rushed to the hospital by paramedics. Officers give a tour of a newly renovated jail in Maricopa County, AZ.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: Officers engage in a high-speed pursuit of a stolen vehicle. Police spot a motel fire, alert the guests and contact the Fire Department. Officers pursue a suspect on a stolen motorcycle.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: Witnesses of a car burglary assist an officer in locating the suspect. An officer investigates a fight involving a young man and a homeless gentleman. A suspect’s testimony is debunked after an eyewitness confirms that his knife wounds were self-inflicted.

programme.title: Cops
programme.sub-title: S13 : E22 Four Legs Beats Two Legs
programme.desc: A suspect on a stolen motorcycle is apprehended with the assistance of the K-9 unit. An Officer responds to a domestic disturbance call after a woman "accidentally" stabs her boyfriend. A hazardous meth lab is busted.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: A jaywalker with no ID bolts away from an officer. A man mixes illicit items with his pizza. A woman involved in a domestic violence call blames her monthly issues.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: A suspect uses bizarre driving techniques to elude cops. A tough officer wades through a forest of denial before finding the crack. Police search for man accused of shooting up the neighborhood.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: A high-speed pursuit ends in a foot chase. Stolen property is found in a suspect’s car during a traffic stop. An altercation ends with a brick being tossed at a victim’s car.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: Officers search for a runaway suspect with a weapons charge. A man admits to having a large number of drugs during a traffic stop. Officers respond to a man with a gun in an alley.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: One suspect takes his chances in a ravine after he leads deputies to a dead end. A vehicle search turns a family outing into a trip to jail. The cops inspect a disturbance between a dad and his son.

programme.title: For Metalheads Only
programme.desc: Leave the rock anthems at the door—this is 100% pure steel. We’ve dialed the distortion to eleven for a lineup strictly for the heavy-duty fans. No compromises, no fillers, just total sonic devastation.

programme.title: Heavy Pumping
programme.desc: Ditch the pre-workout and let the riffs do the heavy lifting. This high-octane blast of speed and power is designed to fuel your gains or ignite a living room mosh pit. High BPMs, crushing drums, and zero excuses.

programme.desc: Stay ahead of the curve with the freshest drops from the global underground. From world premieres to the latest studio masterpieces, we’ve gathered the newest sonic assaults in one place. If it’s loud and new, it’s here.

programme.title: Endless Heavyness
programme.desc: Dive into pure power and unrelenting energy. Endless Heavyness is a non-stop wall of sound designed to hit hard and stay loud. No pauses, no compromises—just the most massive tracks to keep the momentum going. It’s not just loud; it’s eternal.

programme.title: Where Heavy Music Lives
programme.desc: Your official gateway to the underground. Discover your first distorted riff or find a circle of peers who "get it." Welcome to the neighborhood—it’s loud, it’s proud, and there’s always room for one more.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S1 - "What’s Hot in Chile"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 What’s Hot in Chile
programme.desc: Explore a land of extreme contrasts, from the bone-dry Atacama Desert to snowy volcanoes, where ancient history meets vibrant, modern South City life.

programme.title: Big Little Footprints S1 - "Escape To The Rockies"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 Escape To The Rockies
programme.desc: We travel to the UNESCO World Heritage-listed Canadian Rocky Mountains for their stunning natural beauty, historical castles, and epic adventures. This is a destination where protecting its natural resources comes before anything else.

programme.title: Big Little Footprints S1 - "City Escape - Miami"
programme.desc: To educate our children about the profound impact of travel we travel to Miami, Florida. We'll learn about the area's colorful history, taste test its cuisine, learn Latin dancing and experience an epic adventure through the everglades.

programme.title: Big Little Footprints S1 - "Eco-Explore Your Backyard - California Coast to Santa Barbara"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Eco-Explore Your Backyard - California Coast to Santa Barbara
programme.desc: In this episode we remind viewers just how much you can find when exploring your own backyard by road tripping the California Coast to Santa Barbara! Swapping TV time to chats around the campfire and an exciting encounter with sea lions.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S3 - "Sweet Country Home"
programme.desc: Tomarra and Rob had just married and blended their two families. As a new family, they want to transition to a quiet neighbourhood away from the hustle and bustle of Toronto.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S3 - "A Smart Decision"
programme.desc: Darlene and Bruce are in the market for a new home and have enlisted Laura to help them out. Darlene's one request is that they stay close to their current home, where their daughter goes to school.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S3 - "Pool House"
programme.desc: Kathryn and Neil are true urbanites. They love what downtown Toronto has to offer. When Neil found out his company was relocating to Guelph, they weren’t thrilled. After five months of long commutes, the Thompson family is ready to take the risk and make a move—with some conditions. The new house has to have a pool and playroom for the kids and a large entertainment area for adults. Eve’s challenge is to find them an enticing home that will convince their friends from the city to visit.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show S1 - "Ice Hotel, Sweden - Bangkok"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Ice Hotel, Sweden - Bangkok
programme.desc: From the hustle and bustle of Bangkok to the freezing temperatures of the Ice Hotel in Sweden, this episode is all about polar opposites, fire and ice.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show S1 - "St Tropez - St Lucia"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 St Tropez - St Lucia
programme.desc: Romantic Caribbean Islands and sleeping fishing villages turned European jet set resorts, this episode travels from St Lucia to St Tropez.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show S1 - "Ulagala, Sri Lanka - Florence"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 Ulagala, Sri Lanka - Florence
programme.desc: From Michael Angelo’s David in Florence to elephant safaris in Sri Lanka, this is an art lovers and outdoorsy adventure.

programme.title: Travel in Style S1 - "MONACO & VENICE"
programme.desc: Monaco is the home of extravagance, but then let’s not forget the legendary Hotel Cipriani in the wonderful city Venice that is also featured in this glitzy luxury extravaganza.

programme.title: Travel in Style S1 - "SUPERYACHTS"
programme.desc: This glitzy adventure starts in the idyllic town Portofino -Italy, then our super-yacht moors offshore Monaco where we board a privately owned 212 ft, 80 million euro super yacht – The White Rose of Drachs.

programme.title: Travel in Style S1 - "SWITZERLAND & SWEDEN"
programme.desc: Zermatt is one of the most exclusive Ski Resorts in the world. In Sweden, we stayed in award winning 'Victory Hotel' a welcoming and exclusive hotel with a personal atmosphere.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1 - "Paris & Barcelona"
programme.desc: Bones introduce his trademark trickery to people in Paris and Barcelona, performing mind reading and an attempt to escape a straitjacket while breakdancing.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1 - "London"
programme.desc: In this episode Bones is back in his home city, London where he stuns locals with his mind reading, card trickery and disappearing skills.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1 - "South Korea - Night"
programme.desc: Bones is in Seoul, South Korea. He explores the city by night and performs a mixture of magic tricks, including a vanishing trick, coin tricks and card tricks.

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "Hypnotherapy"
programme.desc: In Spain, two best friends reveal their big business plans at the end of a successful summer. A bar inches dangerously close to failure, and a rookie hypnotherapist finds his true calling in France.

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "Shabby Chic"
programme.desc: A couple launches a chic B&B and restaurant in France while stargazers race to finish their observatory & a Costa Blanca bar family battles setbacks.

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "Bar Owner Drama"
programme.desc: In France, the race is on to create a perfect B&B before a big booking arrives, tensions rise in Spain as two owners work together for the very first time, and a pair receive some early guest feedback.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S1 - "The Coolest Places to See Wildlife: Tanzania, the Great Barrier Reef, and the Amazon Rainforest"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 The Coolest Places to See Wildlife: Tanzania, the Great Barrier Reef, and the Amazon Rainforest
programme.desc: Track big cats in the Serengeti, dive the Technicolor Great Barrier Reef, and venture by boat into the heart of the biodiverse Amazon Rainforest.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S1 - "America’s National Parks"
programme.desc: Motor across the USA to climb Yosemite’s cliffs, witness Yellowstone’s geysers, and solve the mystery of the moving stones in scorched Death Valley.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S1 - "Top and Bottom: The World Above the 60th Parallel and Below"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 Top and Bottom: The World Above the 60th Parallel and Below
programme.desc: Plot a course for the world's extremes, using ice breakers and bush planes to explore northern Canada, Iceland, Tasmania, and the tip of Argentina.

programme.title: Luxe Travels S1 - "Cyprus"
programme.desc: Cyprus is the island of love beauty and in this episode of Luxe Travels, Host Sophie Ashley traverses the beautiful Mediterranean island to find out all about the must see and must experience spots in the birth place of Aphrodite!

programme.title: Luxe Travels S1 - "Philippines"
programme.desc: This Luxe Travels episode explores one of Philippines 7000+ islands, and this particular island is voted by most travel publications to be the most beautiful in the world. We are of course talking about the island of Palawan.

programme.title: My Little Cricket Fighter
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore a time-honored form of entertainment in China that has existed for thousands of years – cricket fighting. Music, Chinese chess, calligraphy and painting, and raising flowers, birds, fish and insects are known as the Eight Traditional Pastimes of the Chinese people. Raising insects may be the last on the list, but it is a pastime unique to China. Though these small creatures are tiny, the culture surrounding them has been nurtured by the Chinese people over thousands of years, embodying the unique cultural psychology, folk customs and aesthetic values of the Chinese nation.

programme.title: Echoes of Green
programme.desc: Echoes of Green takes viewers deep into Anji’s bamboo forests and mountain villages, where a new generation of Chinese youth is redefining how to live with nature. Through stories of outdoor sports, forest cafés, tea rituals, and family farms, the series shows how ecological ideals have become everyday choices and creative lifestyles. It is not just about landscapes, but about people — young dreamers proving that prosperity and nature can grow side by side, and that culture gives life to sustainability.

programme.title: Kesi
programme.desc: Silk is a classic symbol of Chinese culture. It helped opened up economic and cultural exchanges between East and West and witnessed the spread of Eastern civilization to the world. As a representative of traditional Chinese silk art, kesi is renowned for its highly ornamental weaving techniques of highlighting warps and breaking wefts, and has been deeply loved by people for thousands of years. In folk culture, it enjoys the reputation of “an inch of kesi is worth an inch of gold.”

programme.title: The Tongliang Dragon Dance
programme.desc: The Tongliang Dragon Dance is a traditional performance art rooted in Chongqing’s Tongliang District, characterized by its elaborate dragon props and dynamic choreography. Originating in the Ming Dynasty and flourishing during the Qing, this vibrant folk tradition has regained its brilliance in modern times and earned international acclaim. The dance consists of two main branches: the dragon lantern dance—featuring forms like the Grand Wriggling Dragon, the Fire Dragon, and the Straw Dragon—and the festive lantern dance, which includes acts such as “Carp Leaps Over the Dragon Gate,” “Mudfish Eating Dumplings,” and “Three Dragons.” Steeped in cultural symbolism, the Tongliang Dragon Dance...

programme.title: Wenzhou
programme.desc: Tianran He is in Wenzhou, southeast China — a city famed for its self-made millionaires. Here he meets the first Chinese shoemaker to expand overseas, and hears the stories of other local entrepreneurs. Along the way, he samples traditional snacks, visits some of China’s oldest lighthouses, and enjoys an evening of Ou Opera. He also learns the craft of papermaking, before heading into the hills to soak in hot springs and wander across ancient covered bridges.

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.3
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He rounds off his travels through Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. He journeys into the Yarlung Zangbo Grand Canyon – one of the largest and deepest canyons on Earth, and along the way, tries to catch a glimpse of Mount Namcha Barwa, the easternmost peak of the Himalayas. Instead, he encounters a waterfall said to be a gateway to the afterlife, before finally arriving at the entrance to the canyon.

Instead, he encounters a waterfall said to be a gateway to the afterlife, before finally arriving at the entrance to the canyon.

programme.title: My Little Cricket Fighter
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore a time-honored form of entertainment in China that has existed for thousands of years – cricket fighting. Music, Chinese chess, calligraphy and painting, and raising flowers, birds, fish and insects are known as the Eight Traditional Pastimes of the Chinese people. Raising insects may be the last on the list, but it is a pastime unique to China. Though these small creatures are tiny, the culture surrounding them has been nurtured by the Chinese people over thousands of years, embodying the unique cultural psychology, folk customs and aesthetic values of the Chinese nation.

programme.title: Echoes of Green
programme.desc: Echoes of Green takes viewers deep into Anji’s bamboo forests and mountain villages, where a new generation of Chinese youth is redefining how to live with nature. Through stories of outdoor sports, forest cafés, tea rituals, and family farms, the series shows how ecological ideals have become everyday choices and creative lifestyles. It is not just about landscapes, but about people — young dreamers proving that prosperity and nature can grow side by side, and that culture gives life to sustainability.

programme.title: Kesi
programme.desc: Silk is a classic symbol of Chinese culture. It helped opened up economic and cultural exchanges between East and West and witnessed the spread of Eastern civilization to the world. As a representative of traditional Chinese silk art, kesi is renowned for its highly ornamental weaving techniques of highlighting warps and breaking wefts, and has been deeply loved by people for thousands of years. In folk culture, it enjoys the reputation of “an inch of kesi is worth an inch of gold.”

programme.title: Painting beyond the spectrum
programme.desc: In many ways, 12-year-old Zhu Jingxiu is just like any other boy his age. He is skilled in drawing, enjoys playing the piano, loves to ride his bicycle, and likes to use his mobile phone to film videos of traffic and skyscrapers.

programme.title: Foodwise: Fuding

From making and eating zongzi rice dumplings to trying local street food, the hosts take part in the festivities before exploring the world of white tea, from visiting its “mother tree” to drinking it in a zen temple, and even feasting on a white tea banquet!

programme.title: Foodwise: Wuyi Mountains
programme.desc: The hosts are in the Wuyi Mountains of Fujian Province, the birthplace of oolong tea. Here they enjoy tea ceremony on a bamboo raft, feast on everything from smoked goose to lotus seed soup, and explore an ancient town that once sold tea to Russia. They discover that here it’s all about terroir, and that nestled within the cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains is the most expensive tea in the world.

programme.title: Grand Song of the Dong — Natural Oriental Harmony
programme.desc: The Grand Song of the Dong is a polyphonic folk singing tradition of the Dong ethnic group. Performers from several villages gather together to sing, unaccompanied.The songs, which describe the history, beliefs, customs, and emotions of the Dong people, are an important part of their cultural identity and contribute significantly to their social cohesion.Generally sung in the Dong language, which has no written form, they are passed on orally from one generation to the next. Classified into various genres—including narrative and love songs, drinking and funeral songs—they are often accompanied by clapping, stomping, and dancing.Sung on occasions such as festivals, weddings, and...

programme.title: Time travel in Shunde: From ancient ancestral halls to dim sum
programme.desc: Two friends, Julian Waghann from the United States and Absalom Absalom from Namibia embarked on a journey to the historic Yang'e Village in Shunde, Guangdong Province. There, they savored authentic morning tea, visited ancient ancestral halls to appreciate the architectural grace and clan heritage of Lingnan, and experienced intangible cultural heritage to the rhythm of lion dance drums.

programme.title: Outkirts of Wenzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He explores Wenzhou’s counties. From geological wonders and daring cliffside stunts at the Yandang Mountains, to rafting along the scenic Nanxi River, to harvesting seaweed and shellfish on the mud flats of the Dongtou Islands, Tianran discovers the ingenious ways the people of Wenzhou have transformed the challenges of living between mountains and seas into their greatest strengths.

programme.title: Life in Camel Town
programme.desc: When it comes to Mongolian, most people will think of grasslands, horse racing. In fact, the camel is the king of five livestock of nomadic people. Camel is the meritorious?figure in the vast desert on the Silk Road. In this episode, we go to Alashan: Camel Town in China, to experience the life of Mongolian people and camels in desert. Milking, delivering milk and collecting camels, also has a thrilling journey to pick up the newborn baby camel. We deeply feel the profound feeling between the camel raiser and their camels.

programme.title: Ding Porcelain Firing
programme.desc: In ancient times, skilled craftsmen combined clay with fire and, using nothing more than their hands and wisdom, created the history of porcelain.A thousand years ago, at the time of the Northern Song Dynasty, a type of porcelain was produced that stood out for its exquisite quality, elegant coloring and beautiful patterns. This was Ding porcelain, and it became a favorite at the imperial court. However, within 200 years, amid the chaos of constant warfare, the art of making it was lost. The dazzling white light of the Ding kilns had faded, seemingly forever. And yet, 800 years later, that light has been reignited.

programme.title: Life in Camel Town

Camel is the meritorious?figure in the vast desert on the Silk Road. In this episode, we go to Alashan: Camel Town in China, to experience the life of Mongolian people and camels in desert. programme.title: Ding Porcelain Firing
programme.desc: In ancient times, skilled craftsmen combined clay with fire and, using nothing more than their hands and wisdom, created the history of porcelain.A thousand years ago, at the time of the Northern Song Dynasty, a type of porcelain was produced that stood out for its exquisite quality, elegant coloring and beautiful patterns. This was Ding porcelain, and it became a favorite at the imperial court. However, within 200 years, amid the chaos of constant warfare, the art of making it was lost. The dazzling white light of the Ding kilns had faded, seemingly forever. And yet, 800 years later, that light has been reignited.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Hung Ga and Choy Li Fut
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber meets with two masters of southern Chinese martial arts. He learns from a Hung Ga master that while this kungfu style is often associated with brute force, it’s actually a combination of hard and soft techniques that can also be used in traditional Chinese massage. Next, Kleber meets a master of Choy Li Fut, a kungfu style that utilizes everyday items such as towels, fans and even abacuses, and discovers the link between martial arts and lion dance.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hangzhou Ep.1
programme.desc: In this episode Tianran and Hannah are in Hangzhou, a city with over 2000 years of history and capital of two ancient Chinese dynasties. From the famous West Lake to delicate Dragon Well tea, our hosts experience Hangzhou's must-do attractions, savouring the local cuisine and trying everything from winter melon shaped like pork belly, to food cooked according to Traditional Chinese Medicine principles, and even Buddhist noodles and Zen tea.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hangzhou Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran and Hannah continue their tea-tasting journey along Hangzhou's Qiantang River, exploring the region's historical culture and culinary delights. They head to Anding Mountain, enjoying misty tea at the summit. In Longmen Ancient Town, they dive into traditional Chinese clan culture and savor “Sun Quan seitan”. In the gentrified village of Shishe, Hannah falls in love with “gray soup rice dumplings”, while at Qiandao Lake Tianran tries the best fish head and beluga caviar he’s ever had in his life. Their journey ends with a cup of Jiukeng tea and a visit to ancient tea trees.

Wherever the procession passes, residents and shopkeepers greet them with firecrackers and burn incense to pray, hoping to receive the unique blessing of the Snake King. programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Hung Ga and Choy Li Fut
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber meets with two masters of southern Chinese martial arts. He learns from a Hung Ga master that while this kungfu style is often associated with brute force, it’s actually a combination of hard and soft techniques that can also be used in traditional Chinese massage. Next, Kleber meets a master of Choy Li Fut, a kungfu style that utilizes everyday items such as towels, fans and even abacuses, and discovers the link between martial arts and lion dance.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hangzhou Ep.1
programme.desc: In this episode Tianran and Hannah are in Hangzhou, a city with over 2000 years of history and capital of two ancient Chinese dynasties. From the famous West Lake to delicate Dragon Well tea, our hosts experience Hangzhou's must-do attractions, savouring the local cuisine and trying everything from winter melon shaped like pork belly, to food cooked according to Traditional Chinese Medicine principles, and even Buddhist noodles and Zen tea.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hangzhou Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran and Hannah continue their tea-tasting journey along Hangzhou's Qiantang River, exploring the region's historical culture and culinary delights. They head to Anding Mountain, enjoying misty tea at the summit. In Longmen Ancient Town, they dive into traditional Chinese clan culture and savor “Sun Quan seitan”. In the gentrified village of Shishe, Hannah falls in love with “gray soup rice dumplings”, while at Qiandao Lake Tianran tries the best fish head and beluga caviar he’s ever had in his life. Their journey ends with a cup of Jiukeng tea and a visit to ancient tea trees.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Hung Ga and Choy Li Fut
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber meets with two masters of southern Chinese martial arts. He learns from a Hung Ga master that while this kungfu style is often associated with brute force, it’s actually a combination of hard and soft techniques that can also be used in traditional Chinese massage. Next, Kleber meets a master of Choy Li Fut, a kungfu style that utilizes everyday items such as towels, fans and even abacuses, and discovers the link between martial arts and lion dance.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hangzhou Ep.1
programme.desc: In this episode Tianran and Hannah are in Hangzhou, a city with over 2000 years of history and capital of two ancient Chinese dynasties. From the famous West Lake to delicate Dragon Well tea, our hosts experience Hangzhou's must-do attractions, savouring the local cuisine and trying everything from winter melon shaped like pork belly, to food cooked according to Traditional Chinese Medicine principles, and even Buddhist noodles and Zen tea.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hangzhou Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran and Hannah continue their tea-tasting journey along Hangzhou's Qiantang River, exploring the region's historical culture and culinary delights. They head to Anding Mountain, enjoying misty tea at the summit. In Longmen Ancient Town, they dive into traditional Chinese clan culture and savor “Sun Quan seitan”. In the gentrified village of Shishe, Hannah falls in love with “gray soup rice dumplings”, while at Qiandao Lake Tianran tries the best fish head and beluga caviar he’s ever had in his life. Their journey ends with a cup of Jiukeng tea and a visit to ancient tea trees.
